title: a line with event analyzed or rule_break, written by an older binary, is an invalid line every reader skips
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, the v0.1.0 cut (the registry event kinds are launch and end)
intent: The registry accepts only `launch` and `end` events. A log written by an older binary can hold `analyzed` and `rule_break` lines: each is an invalid line, skipped like any corrupt line, so the launch before them still reads as running (reap leaves it alone and counts it nowhere), `jitso doctor` counts the two lines as skipped invalid lines, and the file is never rewritten.

stdout.equals: jitso reap: 0 launch(es) marked ended, 0 unlogged worker(s)

stdout.contains: warn registry: .jitso/launches.jsonl: 1 launch, 1 running; 2 invalid lines skipped
